description: Expense approvals built with SvGrid Base for Svelte 5: Expenses and Budgets as linked tables with receipts, approval statuses and what is left of each budget. An approvals board, spend by category, receipts and a submit form, with automations that route big expenses and an Approve button.

faq.question: How do approvals work?
faq.answer: An expense over 1,000 dollars moves to Needs approval with a notice. Approve in the Review column sets it Approved and records who approved it and when. Budgets show Spent as a rollup and Left as a formula, and a category over budget raises a notice.

faq.question: Can it run on my database?
faq.answer: Yes. Give each table a source (baseSource over Postgres, Supabase or your API) and the base loads the records from it and writes every change back; or start from npm create @svgrid@latest -- -t base with your own tables.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
